columns.otc_fin: marginMonitor OTC fin (cost / 成數). Short seed. Bands 145/150 and 205/210 apply only here.
columns.mkt_fin: FinLab TSE+OTC mark-to-market percent, Σ(融資餘額×收盤價)/融資金額. Long series for 1Y/2Y/5Y/ALL.
columns.taiex_close: TAIEX / 加權 close (marginMonitor TSE.close on seed dates, Yahoo ^TWII otherwise)

index_choice: otc_fin is marginMonitor series.OTC[].fin (上櫃, cost / 成數, short seed). mkt_fin is the FinLab TSE+OTC mark-to-market ratio Σ(融資餘額×收盤價)/融資金額, used for 1Y/2Y/5Y/ALL. taiex_close prefers marginMonitor series.TSE[].close on seed dates and Yahoo ^TWII otherwise. ewt_close is Yahoo EWT, the USD Taiwan equity ETF proxy for the 0050/正二 thesis. The two fin columns are different 口徑.
page: docs/index.html reads the CSV only. This JSON is the same rows plus the column contract.
merge: python scripts/fetch_otc_fin.py --merge FILE [--replace] [--overwrite-otc-fin]. Hermes files (tse_fin or source_otc_tse) fill mkt_fin and prices but do not replace marginMonitor otc_fin unless --overwrite-otc-fin. Aliases on non-Hermes files: fin, finRatio, taiex, tse_close, ewt.
